name: brand-ecosystem-core
description: The strategic, verbal and visual layers of the Brand Ecosystem v1.0 as one module: brand-audit, brand-platform, brand-story, brand-touchpoint and brand-launch, the brand-maker and brand-visual ecosystem companions, plus brand-maker (naming), brand-visual (visual identity) and figma-forge (design-system to Figma). Composes with the brand-voice plugin for the voice layer.

interface.shortDescription: Strateji, isimlendirme, görsel kimlik ve Figma odaklı marka ekosistemi.
interface.longDescription: Brand Ecosystem v1.0'ın stratejik, sözel ve görsel katmanları tek modül olarak: brand-audit, brand-platform, brand-story, brand-touchpoint, brand-launch + brand-maker/brand-visual ekosistem yoldaşları + brand-maker (isimlendirme), brand-visual (görsel kimlik) ve figma-forge (tasarım sistemi → Figma). On skill + /pipeline komutu kanonik kurulum sırasını uçtan uca işletir. brand-voice plugin'i ile ses katmanı için kompoze olur. Her skill Claude.ai-native (mcp_servers_required: []); Figma/GoDaddy/Exa opsiyonel zenginleştiricidir.
defaultPrompt: Run the brand ecosystem pipeline for this project.
Audit this brand and propose a sharper platform.
Create a naming and visual identity direction.

figma._use: figma-forge (DS-to-Figma libraries, variables, Code Connect) and brand-visual (visual identity handoff to Figma).

godaddy._use: brand-maker — live domain availability checks during naming validation.

exa._use: brand-audit — competitive landscape and IP/web research.
